figures.title: Pipeline response
figures.calculation: Within each chain, average the 8 matched probe slopes: (order with low outstanding replenishment − order with high outstanding replenishment) / increase in outstanding cases. Then average 10 chains.

figures.title: Total holding + backlog cost
figures.calculation: Sum (0.5 × remaining inventory + 1 × unfilled demand) across all 4 roles and 24 weeks for each chain. Then average 10 chain totals.

figures.title: Inventory-holding cost
figures.calculation: Sum 0.5 × remaining inventory across all 4 roles and 24 weeks for each chain. Then average 10 chain totals.

figures.title: Backlog cost
figures.calculation: Sum 1 × unfilled demand across all 4 roles and 24 weeks for each chain. Then average 10 chain totals.

figures.title: Weekly order variance
figures.calculation: For each role, calculate sample variance of its 24 weekly orders: sum of squared deviations from that role's mean divided by 23. Average the 4 role variances, then average 10 chains.

figures.title: Bullwhip ratio
figures.calculation: Within each chain, divide each role's 24-week sample order variance by that chain's 24-week sample final-consumer-demand variance. Average its 4 role ratios, then average 10 chains. Do not divide pooled means.
